title: Dock and Dine in Miami
description: The best dock-and-dine restaurants in Miami you can reach by boat - where to tie up, what to order, and local tips from the FYI Yachts team.
html:
Top Restaurants to Dock Your Boat

Nothing is better than boating all day and docking at a phenomenal restaurant for a meal.
With the sun guaranteed to work up an appetite, some of the best restaurants in South Florida to dock your boat are right here in Miami. By offering endless dining options to satisfy your hunger cravings for breakfast, lunch or dinner with the luxury of anchoring your boat right at the restaurant, Miami is number one in docking and dining!

Monty’s Raw Bar

2550 S Bayshore Drive, Coconut Grove

You cannot say you have visited Miami until you have spent a night eating and drinking at Monty’s Raw Bar. Being an Icon in Miami, you can find this raw tiki bar along the shores of Biscayne Bay.

Monty’s is a local favorite place to dock and dine, bringing in people from all over the world. This South Florida waterfront restaurant is buzzing with liveliness. This favorite restaurant offers live music, hefty portions, incredible drinks, and, most importantly, delicious Caribbean flavors.

Zuma Miami

270 Biscayne Blvd Way, Downtown Miami

Zuma is a world-known international restaurant famous in London, Hong Kong, Istanbul, Dubai, and Miami. Known for its Japanese izakaya and robata-grill menu experience, this high-class restaurant will leave you luxuriously satisfied. Serving bold, intense flavors inspired by minimalistic, unique, authentic Japanese dishes. Providing its yachting guests with easy boat-up options, this top-notch venture is the way to go after a day at sea!

Seaspice Brasserie & Lounge

422 NW N River Drive, Miami River

Seaspice provides its guests with an elegant, fine-dining experience that will leave you satisfied and wanting to come back. Seaspice elevates gastro-classic dining by preparing its dishes with modern techniques and a heartfelt commitment to quality. With the freshest seafood served right to you, the menu will surely put a smile on your face. If you want to boat up to classy, fine dining, Seaspice is the perfect choice for you

Area 31

270 Biscayne Blvd Way, Miami, FL 33131

Hidden away on the 16th floor of the Epic Hotel in Brickell, this gem serves up incredibly fresh, unique, and delicious food. The menu is full of surprises whether you come for brunch or dinner. Area 31 uses fresh herbs grown on-site, making the food taste even more incredible! With the spectacular city views from the terrace to the tasty drinks served alongside your meal, you are a boat ride away from parking at your next stop, Area 31.

Kiki on the River

50 NW North River Drive, Miami River

Dock your boat and enjoy your dining experience at an all-time Miami favorite waterfront dining restaurant, Kiki on the River!
Decorated as the Greek Isles with a modern spin on old-world, traditional Greek cuisine, this spot will have you pleased, from the dishes to the music. The exotic Greek menu pairs perfectly with the romantic outdoor patio overlooking the water. If you choose to come later in the day, expect to feel a more dancey ambiance.

Lido Restaurant & Bayside Grill

40 Island Avenue, Venetian Island, South Beach

Located in the Standard Hotel, this culinary oasis experience serves a delicious Mediterranean menu with a healthy spa atmosphere. The sunset is truly breathtaking at Lido Bayside Grill, a must-see at the end of the day. You can choose to reserve your boating spot or part-take in Lido’s “first come-first serve” docking. With Lindo’s peaceful waterfront setting, relax and enjoy your next meal with a delicious cocktail at Lido’s.
